provenance.reference: iCom gateway of a heat pump, component list from a diagnostics file
provenance.redaction: only the type and place numbers of the component list are kept; no identifier, serial number, version, name or value

contract: The component list of a real iCom gateway: the controller of the heat pump (172) at the heat generator's place 8, the system controller (158) at place 16 and a remote control (165) at place 56. The roles of 172 at place 8 and 158 at place 16 rest on this list.
